summary: TypeScript code is solid: proper types, error handling, pure functions. Workflow has critical issues: (1) RESULTS_DIR not populated before aggregation step (line 29–37)—runs `bun test` which outputs nothing, then tries to aggregate empty directory, causing workflow to fail with `act`; (2) environment/code mismatch: workflow uses `test-results` but script defaults to `fixtures`; (3) fragile awk parsing (lines 31–37) couples CLI output format to workflow logic; (4) regex XML parser lacks CDATA/namespace support; (5) no markdown cell escaping—pipes in test names break table format. Workflow unclear: is it testing code (unit tests sufficient) or demonstrating on fixtures (requires fixtures pre-committed to repo)? Both attempted but neither properly set up.
